lines: Your father threatens you. Your answer?
His father said: Stop, or I will surely stone you.
Prophet Ibrahim, alayhis salaam, answered: Peace will be upon you. I will ask forgiveness for you of my Lord.
Speak gently to your parents today, even when it's hard. The full movie comes tonight.

beats.text: Your father threatens you. Your answer?
beats.ur: آپ کا باپ آپ کو دھمکائے… آپ کا جواب؟

beats.text: “Stop… or I will surely stone you.”
beats.ur: باز آ جاؤ… ورنہ میں تمہیں سنگسار کر دوں گا

beats.en: Peace will be upon you. I will ask forgiveness for you of my Lord

beats.text: Speak gently to your parents today, even when it's hard.
beats.ur: آج اپنے والدین سے نرمی سے بات کریں، چاہے مشکل ہو
